CFG linearly extrapolates between what t.zh: CFG 在“无提示词时模型会绘制的内容”与“有提示词时模型会绘制的内容”之间作线性外推。将权重 w 从 0 滑至 30，观察生成结果如何朝目标形状拉伸 — 并越过它。
CFG linearly extrapolates between what t.src: CFG linearly extrapolates between what the model would draw without the prompt and what it would draw with the prompt. Slide the weight w from 0 to 30 to see the generation stretch toward — and past — the target shape.

During training, the diffusion model see.zh: 在训练期间，扩散模型会看到有条件与无条件的样本（10% 的提示词被丢弃，替换为 ""）。在推理时，你可以沿条件方向作线性外推：走得越远，模型越激进地遵从提示词 — 直到它过度前进，产生过饱和与振铃伪影。
During training, the diffusion model see.src: During training, the diffusion model sees conditional and unconditional examples (10% of prompts are dropped to ""). At inference, you can linearly extrapolate past the conditional direction: the further you go, the more aggressively the model commits to the prompt — until it overshoots and produces saturated, ringing artifacts.

The sweet spot for Stable Diffusion is r.zh: Stable Diffusion 的最佳区间约为 w ∈ [5, 10]。低于 3 时模型会偏离提示词；高于 15 时便开始出现过饱和（一切都变成鲜明的刻板印象）以及“振铃”（边缘附近的高频伪影）。
The sweet spot for Stable Diffusion is r.src: The sweet spot for Stable Diffusion is roughly w ∈ [5, 10]. Below 3 the model drifts off-prompt; above 15 you start seeing saturation (everything becomes a vivid stereotype) and "ringing" (high-frequency artifacts around edges).

At w=0, you get pure unconditional noise.zh: 当 w=0 时，你得到纯粹的无条件噪声预测（提示词被忽略）。当 w=1 时，你得到条件预测。当 w>1 时，你正在 @@T0@@外推@@T1@@ — 沿提示词方向推进得比模型在训练中见到的更远。伪影之所以出现，正是因为模型将其泛化能力推到了训练时的外推极限之外。
At w=0, you get pure unconditional noise.src: At w=0, you get pure unconditional noise prediction (prompt ignored). At w=1, you get the conditional prediction. Past w=1 you're extrapolating — pushing further in the prompt direction than the model ever saw during training. The model's generalization past its training extrapolation limits is why artifacts appear.

CFG requires a small trick during traini.zh: CFG 在训练时需要一个小技巧：以 10% 的概率随机丢弃提示词（替换为空条件）。这使同一个模型同时学会 @@T0@@既@@T1@@ 能进行条件生成又能进行无条件生成。在推理时，每步运行两次前向传播 — 一次带提示词，一次为空 — 然后作外推。
CFG requires a small trick during traini.src: CFG requires a small trick during training: randomly drop the prompt 10% of the time (replace with null/empty conditioning). This teaches the same model to do both conditional and unconditional generation. At inference you run two forward passes per step — one with the prompt, one with the null — and extrapolate.
